en-US.name: Maximum Radio
en-US.summary: Streams a single fixed internet radio station.
en-US.description: A personal Alexa skill that streams one fixed internet radio station using the AudioPlayer interface. Say 'Alexa, open maximum radio' to start listening.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask maximum radio to play
Alexa, tell maximum radio to stop

de-DE.name: Maximum Radio
de-DE.description: Ein persönlicher Alexa-Skill, der einen festen Internetradiosender über die AudioPlayer-Schnittstelle streamt. Sage 'Alexa, öffne maximum radio', um mit dem Hören zu beginnen.
examplePhrases: Alexa, bitte maximum radio zu spielen
Alexa, sag maximum radio zu stoppen

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, open maximum radio' to start the stream. Say 'pause', 'resume', or 'stop' to control playback.
